QuestionStmt.S: Select false statement from the following regarding electrochemical cell.

Option1Stmt.S: Standard cell potential of electrochemical cell is an intensive property.

Option2Stmt.S: Electrode potential depends on concentration of salt solution in contact with electrode.

Option3Stmt.S: Standard free energy change of cell is an intensive property.

Option4Stmt.S: Electrical work done in galvanic cell is equal to decrease in Gibbs energy.

Solution.S:
Let us analyse each statement:

Option A: "Standard cell potential of electrochemical cell is an intensive property."

Intensive properties do not depend on the amount of the substance. Standard cell potential (E°cell) is indeed intensive.

Option B: "Electrode potential depends on concentration of salt solution in contact with electrode."

Electrode potential does depend on the concentration (see Nernst equation), so this statement is true.

Option C: "Standard free energy change of cell is an intensive property."

Standard free energy change (ΔG°) depends on the number of moles of electrons (n), as

ΔG° = -nFE°cell

So, ΔG° is an extensive property, not intensive.

Option D: "Electrical work done in galvanic cell is equal to decrease in Gibbs energy."

This is true: Electrical work = -ΔG.

Conclusion:

The false statement is:

Option C

Reason: Standard free energy change (ΔG°) is an extensive property, not intensive.
